guide.goal: 大考中心學測與技專統測命題規準：分詞構句、獨立分詞、假設語氣全貌、分裂強調句、倒裝句與 ESP 科技論文。
guide.motivation: 分詞構句是英文追求「簡潔、節奏與優雅」的極致體現。在不引發歧義的前提下，將冗長的副詞子句精煉為分詞片語，是英美主流期刊與學術寫作的標誌性特徵。

tips.title: 副詞子句化為分詞構句三步驟 (Three Steps to Participle Clauses)
tips.formula: 1. 省略連接詞 (若意思明確) -> 2. 省略相同主詞 -> 3. 主動化為 V-ing，被動化為 V-p.p. (省略 being)
tips.body: 主動進行用現在分詞 V-ing；被動或完成狀態用過去分詞 V-p.p.；否定詞 not 置於分詞最前面。
tips.example: Because he felt exhausted, he fell asleep. => Feeling exhausted, he fell asleep. / Because it was damaged by hail, the roof leaked. => Damaged by hail, the roof leaked.

tips.title: 分詞形容詞情緒動詞對比 (Emotive Participial Adjectives)
tips.formula: V-ing (令人感到...的，指事物本質) vs. V-p.p. (某人感到...的，指內心狀態)
tips.body: 令人興奮的比賽是 exciting match；感到興奮的觀眾是 excited spectators。指物通常用 V-ing，指人心情通常用 V-p.p.。
tips.example: The confusing explanation left all the confused students even more perplexed.

traps.wrong: Seen from the space station, the Earth looks like a blue marble. (若主要子句主詞是 astronauts 則錯誤)
traps.correct: Seen from the space station, the Earth looks like a blue marble. (因為是地球被看見)
traps.reason: 分詞片語的主詞必須與主句主詞保持嚴格一致，否則會形成懸垂分詞 (Dangling Participle)。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Walking into the hall, I noticed everyone staring at the screen.
dialogue.zh: 我走進大廳時，發現大家都盯著螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Was the presentation interesting?

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Yes, but I was confused by the first chart.
dialogue.zh: 很有趣，不過第一張圖讓我有點困惑。

dialogue.speaker: Ben

我能徹底避免懸垂分詞 (Dangling Participle) 寫作錯誤
guide.level: B1+ ~ B2 (學測前標與統測外語)

extra.title: 分詞修飾與分詞構句
extra.rule: 現在分詞常表主動或進行，過去分詞常表被動或完成。分詞構句省略的主詞須與主要子句相容。
flow: 主動用 ing／被動用分詞

rows: The student using the drill is Sam.
Wearing gloves, Sam handled the parts.
Walking home, I saw a bus.
走路的是 I，不是 bus。

extra.trap: 錯：Walking home, the rain started. 會把 rain 當成走路者。改 As I was walking home, it started to rain。

guide.goal: 大考中心學測與技專統測命題規準：分詞構句、獨立分詞、假設語氣全貌、分裂強調句、倒裝句與 ESP 科技論文。
guide.motivation: 當副詞子句與主要子句主詞「不同」時，子句主詞必須保留，形成「獨立分詞構句 (Nominative Absolute)」。此外，還有不受主詞限制的慣用評估分詞 (Generally speaking, judging from)，為大考綜合測驗必考核心。

tips.title: 獨立分詞構句公式 (The Nominative Absolute Construction)
tips.formula: Subject 1 + V-ing / V-p.p., Subject 2 + Verb...
tips.body: 前後主詞不同時，省略連接詞但保留子句主詞。常出現在表天氣、時間、伴隨狀況之語境。
tips.example: Weather permitting, we will set sail at dawn. (若天氣允許，我們將在破曉啟航)

tips.title: with + 受詞 + 受詞補語之伴隨態 (Absolute 'with' Structure)
tips.formula: with + O + V-ing (主動進行) / V-p.p. (被動完成) / Adj / Prep Phrase
tips.body: 用 with 引導名詞與受詞補語，表達伴隨發生的動作或身體狀態。
tips.example: He listened intently with his arms folded across his chest.

tips.title: 慣用懸置分詞 (Idiomatic Dangling Participles)
tips.formula: Generally speaking (一般而言) | Judging from (從...來判斷) | Frankly speaking (坦白說)
tips.body: 這些慣用片語已演變為獨立副詞功能，不受主句主詞一致性規則的限制。
tips.example: Judging from his accent, he must be a native of Scotland.

traps.wrong: Judging from his grades, the teacher praised him. (意思變成老師從成績看，而非習慣語)
traps.correct: Judging from his grades, he is an exceptional student.
traps.reason: Judging from 習慣引導客觀事實或對該主詞的評價推論，後面主句主詞通常是所評價之對象。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: The report says, 'Weather permitting, we'll launch on Friday.' What does that mean?
dialogue.zh: 報告說「Weather permitting, we'll launch on Friday」，是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: It means we'll launch if the weather allows it.
dialogue.zh: 就是天氣允許的話，週五發射。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: So weather is the subject of permitting?
dialogue.zh: 所以 permitting 的主詞是 weather？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Right. In conversation, I'd usually just say, 'If the weather's good.'
dialogue.zh: 對。一般聊天我通常直接說「如果天氣好」。

checklist: 我能正確建構前後主詞不同的獨立分詞構句 (Nominative Absolute)
我能熟練運用 with + O + V-ing / V-p.p. 描寫人物生動動作與神態
guide.level: B1+ ~ B2 (學測前標與統測外語)

guide.goal: 大考中心學測與技專統測命題規準：分詞構句、獨立分詞、假設語氣全貌、分裂強調句、倒裝句與 ESP 科技論文。
guide.motivation: 假設語氣是高中英語文法的最高巔峰。它並非單純描述事實，而是表達「與事實相反的願望、假想、推測或遺憾」。掌握「時態往過去倒退一格」的宇宙法則，即可縱橫所有大考題型。

tips.title: 與現在相反之假設 (Subjunctive Unreal Present)
tips.formula: If + S + were / V-ed, S + would/could/should/might + V-原形
tips.body: 與現在事實相反，子句動詞用過去式 (正式反事實用法常用 were，非正式語境也可見 was)；主要子句用助動詞過去式 + 原形動詞。
tips.example: If I were a billionaire, I would fund marine plastic cleanup operations globally.

tips.title: 與過去相反之假設 (Subjunctive Unreal Past)
tips.formula: If + S + had + p.p., S + would/could/should/might + have + p.p.
tips.body: 與過去事實相反，子句動詞用過去完成式 had p.p.；主要子句用 would/could/should/might + have + p.p.。
tips.example: If we had left ten minutes earlier, we would not have missed the high-speed rail.

tips.title: 與未來相反之純假想 (Subjunctive Unreal Future)
tips.formula: If + S + were to / should + V-原形, S + would/could + V-原形
tips.body: were to 可提出較假設性的未來情境，不代表絕不可能；should 可表較正式、較不確定的條件，也不指定機率。
tips.example: If the sun were to rise in the west, I would still honor my promise.

traps.wrong: If I would have known, I would have told you.
traps.correct: If I had known, I would have told you.
traps.reason: if 條件子句中絕不能出現 would have p.p.，只能用 had p.p.；would have p.p. 只能放在主要子句中！

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: If you'd left earlier, would you have caught the train?
dialogue.zh: 如果你早一點出門，會趕上那班車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Probably. If I'd caught it, I would have arrived before the interview.
dialogue.zh: 應該會。如果趕上，我就能在面試前抵達。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: What would you do differently next time?

dialogue.speaker: Ben

checklist: 我能精確默寫與現在、過去、未來相反假設語氣的子句與主句動詞公式
我能在 if 條件子句中絕不誤用 would have p.p.
guide.level: B1+ ~ B2 (學測前標與統測外語)

extra.title: 條件句與假設語氣
extra.rule: 條件句要同時看時間與真實可能性。用過去形談現在假設，並不代表事情發生在過去。

rows: If you heat ice, it melts.
If it rains, we will stay inside.
If I had more time, I would study robotics.
If I had checked it, I would have found the fault.

extra.trap: 一般未來條件的 if 子句通常不用 will。正式建議常用 If I were you。

guide.goal: 大考中心學測與技專統測命題規準：分詞構句、獨立分詞、假設語氣全貌、分裂強調句、倒裝句與 ESP 科技論文。
guide.motivation: 學測指考最高難度文法雙璧：1. 過去因影響現在果的「混合假設語氣」；2. 為了行文典雅與節奏而「省略 if 的倒裝句型」。掌握這兩項，各大名校模擬考無往不利。

tips.title: 混合假設語氣 (Mixed Conditionals: Past Cause -> Present Effect)
tips.formula: If + S + had + p.p. (過去), S + would/could + V-原形 + now / today (現在)
tips.body: 條件子句是過去發生的事 (had p.p.)，但主要子句描述的是對「現在 (now)」造成的影響，主句使用 would + V-原形！
tips.example: If she had taken the vaccine last winter, she would not be sick in bed right now.

tips.title: 省略 If 之倒裝三部曲 (Inversion by Omitting 'If')
tips.formula: Were + S... | Had + S + p.p... | Should + S + V-原形...
tips.body: 將 if 省略時，子句必須將助動詞或 be 動詞 (Were, Had, Should) 倒裝提至主詞之前！若有 not，not 留在主詞後方。
tips.example: If I had known => Had I known. / If you should see him => Should you see him. / If it were not for => Were it not for.

traps.wrong: Had not he arrived in time, we would have failed.
traps.correct: Had he not arrived in time, we would have failed.
traps.reason: 省略 if 倒裝時，否定詞 not 不可與 Had 縮寫或一起提到句首，必須留在主詞之後。

dialogue.en: Had I known the course was online, I wouldn't have booked a hotel.

dialogue.speaker: Ben

dialogue.speaker: Maya

guide.goal: 大考中心學測與技專統測命題規準：分詞構句、獨立分詞、假設語氣全貌、分裂強調句、倒裝句與 ESP 科技論文。
guide.motivation: 倒裝 (Inversion) 是英語營造修辭戲劇張力 (rhetorical drama) 與焦點突出的強大武器。掌握否定副詞 (Never, Seldom, Rarely, Little, Not only) 置於句首的不完全倒裝，以及地方副詞 (Here, There, On the hill) 置首的完全倒裝。

tips.title: 否定副詞置首不完全倒裝 (Negative Adverbial Inversion - Auxiliary First)
tips.formula: Negative Word (Never / Seldom / Rarely / Little / Not only / Hardly) + Auxiliary / Be + Subject + Main Verb...
tips.body: 否定副詞提至句首時，語序如同一般疑問句：助動詞 (do/does/did/have/can/will) 或 be 動詞必須倒裝提到主詞前方！
tips.example: Never in human history have so many individuals possessed instantaneous access to global knowledge.

tips.title: 地方副詞置首完全倒裝 (Locative Inversion - Verb Before Subject)
tips.formula: Prep Phrase / Adverb of Place (On the hill / Under the tree / Here) + Verb + Noun Subject
tips.body: 地方副詞提至句首時，若主詞為普通名詞，整顆動詞直接搬到主詞前方 (完全倒裝)；但若主詞為代名詞 (he, they)，則不倒裝！
tips.example: At the foot of the mountain stood an ancient pagoda. vs. Here comes the bus! / Here it comes!

traps.wrong: Under the bridge a strange man stood. (可接受但未倒裝) vs. Under the bridge did stand a strange man.
traps.correct: Under the bridge stood a strange man.
traps.reason: 地方副詞置首是「完全倒裝」，整顆不及物動詞直接搬到主詞前，不需要也不可以借用助動詞 did！

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: The speaker said, 'Never have we faced a challenge like this.'
dialogue.zh: 講者說「Never have we faced a challenge like this」。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: That's stronger than saying, 'We've never faced a challenge like this.'
dialogue.zh: 比直接說「我們從沒面對過這種挑戰」更有強調感。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Would you use that word order in a text to a friend?
dialogue.zh: 傳訊息給朋友時，你會用那種語序嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Probably not. I'd save it for a speech or formal writing.
dialogue.zh: 大概不會。我會留在演講或正式寫作使用。

checklist: 我能熟練寫出 Never / Seldom / Little 置首的不完全倒裝句
我能分辨地方副詞完全倒裝中「普通名詞倒裝、代名詞不倒裝」的關鍵鐵律
guide.level: B1+ ~ B2 (學測前標與統測外語)

extra.title: 主詞一致、倒裝與強調
extra.rule: 先找真正的主詞，別讓插入的介系詞片語干擾動詞單複數。倒裝與強調結構則改變排列，但仍需完整語法。

rows: The box of tools is heavy.
Never have I seen this problem.
否定語放句首，助動詞到主詞前。
It was Sam who found the fault.

extra.trap: Each of the students is ready. 的核心是 Each，用單數；不要只看最近的名詞。

guide.goal: 大考中心學測與技專統測命題規準：分詞構句、獨立分詞、假設語氣全貌、分裂強調句、倒裝句與 ESP 科技論文。
guide.motivation: 英文追求句型的「平行對稱 (Parallelism)」與「頭輕腳重」的流暢韻律。掌握 So + Adj / Such + Be 置首的結果倒裝句，以及 Not only... but also...、Neither... nor... 的平衡結構，是大學指考/學測英文寫作邁向 16 分以上的必備功力。

tips.title: So... that... 與 Such... that... 倒裝 (Inversion of So/Such Result Clauses)
tips.formula: So + Adj/Adv + Be/Auxiliary + Subject + that... | Such + Be + Subject + that...
tips.body: 將「如此...以致於...」的 So + 形容詞提至句首加強語氣時，前半句倒裝，that 後面子句維持正常語序。
tips.example: So intense was the summer heatwave that asphalt roads began to soften.

tips.title: Neither / Nor 的附和倒裝 (Negative Agreement Inversion)
tips.formula: S + negative verb...; neither / nor + Be/Auxiliary + Subject
tips.body: 表達「某人/某物也不...」時，neither / nor 後面必須將 be 動詞或助動詞提至主詞之前。
tips.example: The pilot could not see through the dense fog, nor could the radar detect the mountain ridge.

traps.wrong: He doesn't like spicy food, and I don't too.
traps.correct: He doesn't like spicy food, and neither do I. (or: I don't either.)
traps.reason: 否定附和句不能用 too，只能用 either (放句尾) 或 neither + 助動詞 + 主詞 (倒裝)。

guide.goal: 大考中心學測與技專統測命題規準：分詞構句、獨立分詞、假設語氣全貌、分裂強調句、倒裝句與 ESP 科技論文。
guide.motivation: 分裂句 (Cleft Sentence) 是母語人士調整句子資訊焦點 (Focus) 的終極工具。將要強調的主詞、受詞或副詞片語夾在 'It is/was... that...' 之間，能使特定訊息產生強烈聚焦光環。

tips.title: 分裂句標準公式與還原檢驗法 (Cleft Sentence Formula & Test)
tips.formula: It is / was + [強調焦點 (S / O / Adv Phrase)] + that / who + [剩餘句子成分]
tips.body: 檢驗方法：若把 'It is/was' 和 'that' 同時拿掉，剩下的單字能重新還原拼成一句完整的正常句子，就是分裂強調句！
tips.example: Columbus reached the Americas in 1492. => It was in 1492 that Columbus reached the Americas.

tips.title: Wh- 分裂句 (Pseudo-cleft Sentences)
tips.formula: What + S + V + is / was + [強調焦點]
tips.body: 以 what 子句作為主詞，將整個句子的核心焦點推移至 be 動詞之後。
tips.example: What the biosphere urgently requires is substantive decarbonization, not hollow pledges.

traps.wrong: It was in Taipei where we first met. (口語可見但學測大考視為非標準文法)
traps.correct: It was in Taipei that we first met.
traps.reason: 學測指考等正式學術英語規範中，分裂句強調地方副詞片語時，規範引導詞一律使用 that，不可任意代換為 where。

guide.goal: 大考中心學測與技專統測命題規準：分詞構句、獨立分詞、假設語氣全貌、分裂強調句、倒裝句與 ESP 科技論文。
guide.motivation: 學測 14-15 級分頂標選手與一般考生的分水嶺！讓步倒裝 (Adj / Adv / N / V + as / though + S + V) 在大考閱讀測驗中頻繁出現，掌握此句型能瞬間看透篇章深層語義。

tips.title: As / Though 讓步倒裝公式 (Concession Inversion with As/Though)
tips.formula: Adj / Adv / V / N (無冠詞) + as / though + S + V, S + V...
tips.body: 意為「雖然...、儘管...」。將形容詞、副詞、原形動詞或名詞 (不可加冠詞 a/an) 提至 as/though 前方！注意：although 絕不可用於此倒裝結構！
tips.example: Rich as he is, he remains humble. / Child as she was, she displayed astonishing courage. / Hard as they tried, they failed.

tips.title: 高級讓步與假設片語 (Advanced Idiomatic Concessions)
tips.formula: Be it A or B (無論是A還是B) | Come what may (無論發生什麼) | Be that as it may (儘管如此)
tips.body: 源自古英語虛擬式原形倒裝，廣泛保留於現代新聞評論、法學與大考長文中。
tips.example: Every participant must register, be they students or renowned scholars.

traps.wrong: Brave although he was, he could not defeat the beast.
traps.correct: Brave though/as he was, he could not defeat the beast.
traps.reason: although 絕不能用於倒裝讓步結構，倒裝時只能用 as 或 though！

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Even though the pilot was expensive, the results look promising.
dialogue.zh: 雖然試辦成本很高，結果看來很有希望。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: True, but even if we get more funding, we still need trained staff.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，但即使拿到更多經費，還是需要受過訓練的人員。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Should we mention both points in the proposal?
dialogue.zh: 提案要把兩點都寫進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Yes. We should explain the benefit without hiding the limits.
dialogue.zh: 要。我們應該說明好處，也清楚交代限制。

guide.level: B1+ ~ B2 (學測前標與統測外語)

guide.goal: 大考中心學測與技專統測命題規準：分詞構句、獨立分詞、假設語氣全貌、分裂強調句、倒裝句與 ESP 科技論文。
guide.motivation: ESP (English for Specific Purposes) 專業英文已是大考與技高外語群主軸。人工智慧、演算法、自然語言處理、大型語言模型 (LLM) 的學術文獻高頻出現在跨學科閱讀題中，掌握專業詞彙與論證邏輯是未來雙語人才的基石。

tips.title: 學術科技英文摘要四大結構 (Four Pillars of Academic Abstracts)
tips.formula: Objective (研究目的) -> Methodology (研究方法) -> Findings (實驗結果) -> Implications (實務意涵)
tips.body: 科技論文摘要依循嚴密脈絡。善用定位詞快速抓取核心貢獻。
tips.example: This paper proposes a novel Transformer architecture capable of mitigating hallucinations in LLMs.

tips.title: 科技詞彙構詞法：字根與字首拆解 (Affixation in Technical ESP)
tips.formula: neuro- (神經) | bio- (生物) | auto- (自動) | trans- (轉變/跨越) | -ification (名詞化)
tips.body: 字根字首可提供推測線索，但不能保證推得詞義；仍需用上下文與字典核對。
tips.example: Autonomous neuromuscular synchronization allows bionic prosthetics to emulate natural limb movements.

traps.wrong: 一看到長篇學術縮寫 (如 RLHF, LLM) 就放棄不讀。
traps.correct: 在文中找到第一次出現該縮寫的地方，前方或括號內必定有全名與簡要定義。
traps.reason: 學術英語規範規定所有專用縮寫在文章首次出現時必須提供完整全稱拼寫。

dialogue.en: This AI model reports ninety-five percent accuracy. Is that enough for our project?
dialogue.zh: 這個 AI 模型報告準確率百分之九十五，夠我們專題用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: We need to know what data it was tested on.
dialogue.zh: 我們得先知道它用什麼資料測試。

dialogue.speaker: Maya

guide.level: B1+ ~ B2 (學測前標與統測外語)

guide.goal: 大考中心學測與技專統測命題規準：分詞構句、獨立分詞、假設語氣全貌、分裂強調句、倒裝句與 ESP 科技論文。
guide.motivation: 聯合國永續發展目標 (SDGs 1-17) 與企業 ESG (環境、社會、公司治理) 是現今大考閱讀與英文寫作的最熱門題庫。本單元建立碳足跡、循環經濟、再生能源與氣候正義的高階論辯詞彙庫。

tips.title: 永續發展論證高頻架構 (Argumentation in Environmental Discourse)
tips.formula: Current Crisis (生態現況) -> Root Cause (人為成因) -> Proposed Solution (制度/科技方案) -> Call to Action (呼籲行動)
tips.body: 英文永續倡議文本通常遵循此四段論式結構。考生在寫作時亦可套用此模板以達結構嚴謹度。
tips.example: Transitioning from fossil fuels to offshore wind requires substantial grid modernization.

tips.title: 綠色經濟高頻搭配詞 (High-Frequency Collocations in Green Economy)
tips.formula: carbon neutral (碳中和) | circular economy (循環經濟) | ecological footprint (生態足跡) | sustainable agriculture (永續農業)
tips.body: 大考克漏字與寫作評分特別偏好道地的專業搭配詞組，能大幅提升論述的專業說服力。
tips.example: The conglomerate pledged to achieve net-zero carbon neutrality across all operations by 2040.

traps.wrong: 把 sustainable 當成 sustain (支撐) 翻譯為「可維持支撐的」。
traps.correct: 在環境永續語境下，sustainable 專指「環境可持續發展、不耗竭地球資源的」。
traps.reason: 大考常以一字多義出題，考生必須依據主題領域 (Domain) 選擇合宜語義。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Should our school put solar panels on the gym roof?
dialogue.zh: 學校該在體育館屋頂裝太陽能板嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: It could reduce our electricity bills, but we need a cost estimate.
dialogue.zh: 可能降低電費，但需要成本估算。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: We should also check how much shade the nearby trees create.
dialogue.zh: 也該看看附近樹木造成多少遮蔭。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Agreed. Let's compare the expected output with the installation and maintenance costs.
dialogue.zh: 同意。我們比較預期發電量和安裝、維護成本。

我能在英文作文中針對氣候變遷提出具備系統思考的論點與具體解方
guide.level: B1+ ~ B2 (學測前標與統測外語)

guide.goal: 大考中心學測與技專統測命題規準：分詞構句、獨立分詞、假設語氣全貌、分裂強調句、倒裝句與 ESP 科技論文。
guide.motivation: 學測篇章結構 (Discourse Structure) 是鑑別頂標 (13-15級分) 的核心關卡。透過代名詞定錨、主題詞同義代換、時間順序鏈、因果關聯推導四大破解密碼，徹底掌握五題全對的秘訣。

tips.title: 篇章連貫四大定錨法則 (Four Anchoring Principles of Discourse Cohesion)
tips.formula: 1. 代名詞定錨 (they, this, such) -> 2. 定冠詞特定指稱 (the + N) -> 3. 轉折語流 (However, Thus) -> 4. 語意回響 (Lexical Reiteration)
tips.body: 檢查空格前後的指涉與邏輯，必要時回看整段；線索數量不固定，也不一定出現代名詞。
tips.example: Sentence A mentions 'Dr. Evans launched a project.' Option C begins with 'This ambitious endeavor...'

traps.wrong: 看到選項裡有跟文章一樣的單字就急著選進去。
traps.correct: 檢查該選項放進空格後，是否能同時跟「前句」和「後句」在邏輯與代名詞上雙向通順。
traps.reason: 大考出題者最喜歡在干擾選項中故意放入文章原字，引誘只看單字不看整段邏輯的考生入坑。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Where should this sentence about the survey's limitations go?
dialogue.zh: 這句談調查限制的句子該放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: After the results, before the author gives a recommendation.
dialogue.zh: 放在結果之後、作者提出建議之前。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Because readers need to understand how certain the findings are?
dialogue.zh: 因為讀者需要先知道研究結果有多確定？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Exactly. It also explains why the recommendation is cautious.
dialogue.zh: 對，也能解釋為什麼建議比較謹慎。

checklist: 我能熟練運用代名詞定錨法則秒殺篇章結構選項
我做篇章結構題時能堅持「前看一句、後看一句」的雙向驗證步驟
guide.level: B1+ ~ B2 (學測前標與統測外語)

extra.title: 閱讀故事、詩歌與短劇：情節、韻律與感想
extra.rule: 故事要素：setting（背景）、characters（人物）、conflict（衝突）、climax（高潮）、resolution（結局）。短劇另有舞台指示（stage directions，常以斜體或括號表示）與對白，朗讀時要用語氣呈現人物情緒。詩歌欣賞看三點：押韻與節奏（rhyme、meter）、意象（imagery，用感官描寫）、修辭（simile 明喻 like/as、metaphor 暗喻、personification 擬人）。寫心得用「摘要一句 → 引用一句 → 分析效果 → 個人連結」。
pairs: The wind whispered through the trees.
擬人：風「低語」，營造安靜神秘的氣氛。
Her smile was as bright as the morning sun.
(She slams the door.) MOM: Come back here!
extra.trap: 常見錯誤：心得只寫 I like this story. It is good.，缺乏引用與分析；或把 simile 和 metaphor 混淆：有 like / as 的是明喻。
extra.model: The poem describes a child waiting for her father to return from sea. The line “the waves sang a lonely song” personifies the sea, making the waiting feel sadder. The repeated rhyme of “shore” and “more” creates a slow, steady rhythm like the tide. It reminded me of waiting for my grandparents at the airport. 檢查：有摘要、引用、分析與個人連結嗎？

guide.goal: 大考中心學測與技專統測命題規準：分詞構句、獨立分詞、假設語氣全貌、分裂強調句、倒裝句與 ESP 科技論文。
guide.motivation: 高二全冊終極封頂驗收。結合分詞構句、獨立分詞、假設語氣全系列、倒裝句、分裂句、讓步倒裝、ESP 科技與永續長文，打造具備大考頂標水準的綜合試煉場，引領學子邁入高三大考決勝舞台。

tips.title: 高難度長篇閱讀三階速讀心法 (Three-Stage Velocity Reading for GSAT)
tips.formula: Stage 1: Topic Sentence Skim (每段首尾句 45 秒抓大意) -> Stage 2: Question Keyword Scan (題幹定位 30 秒) -> Stage 3: Deep Syntactic Parsing (長難句精準拆解)
tips.body: 面對大考長達 1200 字的多篇閱讀題組，切莫一字一字死讀。首段抓議題、各段首句抓論點、末段抓結論，再帶題檢索精確定位。
tips.example: Skim paragraph 1 for the main thesis; scan for capitalized proper nouns mentioned in Question 38.

traps.wrong: 在大考閱讀測驗中，因為緊張而將全文從頭到尾每個字讀三遍導致寫不完。
traps.correct: 嚴格執行「題幹關鍵字定位法」，直奔答案段落精讀三行即可作答。
traps.reason: 大考閱讀測驗比拼的是「閱讀策略與資訊檢索效率」，而非逐字默背全文。

g11-s1-u1.tip1.title: 副詞子句化為分詞構句三步驟 (Three Steps to Participle Clauses)
g11-s1-u1.tip1.formula: 1. 省略連接詞 (若意思明確) -> 2. 省略相同主詞 -> 3. 主動化為 V-ing，被動化為 V-p.p. (省略 being)
g11-s1-u1.tip1.body: 主動進行用現在分詞 V-ing；被動或完成狀態用過去分詞 V-p.p.；否定詞 not 置於分詞最前面。
g11-s1-u1.tip1.example: Because he felt exhausted, he fell asleep. => Feeling exhausted, he fell asleep. / Because it was damaged by hail, the roof leaked. => Damaged by hail, the roof leaked.

g11-s1-u1.x1.prompt: All sensitive personal data on our server ___ using AES-256 military-grade encryption before being transmitted.
g11-s1-u1.x1.hint: 先判斷主詞 data 和 protect 是主動還是被動關係，再看句子描述的是不是一般常態。
g11-s1-u1.x1.why: 【考點解構】主詞 All sensitive personal data 與動詞 protect 為被動關係（數據是被保護），且表示日常安全常態原則，故使用現在被動式 is protected。

g11-s1-u1.tip2.title: 分詞形容詞情緒動詞對比 (Emotive Participial Adjectives)
g11-s1-u1.tip2.formula: V-ing (令人感到...的，指事物本質) vs. V-p.p. (某人感到...的，指內心狀態)
g11-s1-u1.tip2.body: 令人興奮的比賽是 exciting match；感到興奮的觀眾是 excited spectators。指物通常用 V-ing，指人心情通常用 V-p.p.。
g11-s1-u1.tip2.example: The confusing explanation left all the confused students even more perplexed.

g11-s1-u1.x2.hint: V-ing (令人感到...的，指事物本質) vs. V-p.p. (某人感到...的，指內心狀態)
g11-s1-u1.x2.why: boring 描述事物令人無聊；bored 描述人感到無聊。

g11-s1-u2.tip1.title: 獨立分詞構句公式 (The Nominative Absolute Construction)
g11-s1-u2.tip1.body: 前後主詞不同時，省略連接詞但保留子句主詞。常出現在表天氣、時間、伴隨狀況之語境。

g11-s1-u2.x1.prompt: ___ by the spectacular aurora borealis in northern Norway, the tourists stood in stunned silence for hours.
g11-s1-u2.x1.hint: 主要子句的主詞是 the tourists：遊客是「吸引別人」，還是「被吸引」？
g11-s1-u2.x1.why: 【考點解構】分詞修飾主要子句主詞 the tourists；遊客是被極光「深深吸引 (be fascinated by)」，省略連接詞與主詞後，被動語態保留過去分詞 Fascinated。

g11-s1-u2.tip2.title: with + 受詞 + 受詞補語之伴隨態 (Absolute 'with' Structure)
g11-s1-u2.tip2.formula: with + O + V-ing (主動進行) / V-p.p. (被動完成) / Adj / Prep Phrase
g11-s1-u2.tip2.body: 用 with 引導名詞與受詞補語，表達伴隨發生的動作或身體狀態。
g11-s1-u2.tip2.example: He listened intently with his arms folded across his chest.

g11-s1-u2.x2.prompt: All sensitive personal data on our server ___ using AES-256 military-grade encryption before being transmitted.

g11-s1-u2.x2.why: 【考點解構】主詞 All sensitive personal data 與動詞 protect 為被動關係（數據是被保護），且表示日常安全常態原則，故使用現在被動式 is protected。

g11-s1-u2.tip3.title: 慣用懸置分詞 (Idiomatic Dangling Participles)
g11-s1-u2.tip3.formula: Generally speaking (一般而言) | Judging from (從...來判斷) | Frankly speaking (坦白說)
g11-s1-u2.tip3.body: 這些慣用片語已演變為獨立副詞功能，不受主句主詞一致性規則的限制。
g11-s1-u2.tip3.example: Judging from his accent, he must be a native of Scotland.

g11-s1-u2.x3.prompt: ___ from his accent, the speaker probably grew up in Scotland.
g11-s1-u2.x3.hint: 這是不必和主要子句主詞一致的慣用分詞片語，類似 generally speaking、frankly speaking。
g11-s1-u2.x3.why: Judging from…（從…判斷）是慣用的獨立分詞片語，不需要和主句主詞一致。Judged 是被動形式，語意不通。

g11-s1-u2.q1.prompt: The young philosopher sat silently by the fireplace, with his fingers ________ together in deep contemplation.

g11-s1-u3.tip1.title: 與現在相反之假設 (Subjunctive Unreal Present)
g11-s1-u3.tip1.formula: If + S + were / V-ed, S + would/could/should/might + V-原形
g11-s1-u3.tip1.body: 與現在事實相反，子句動詞用過去式 (正式反事實用法常用 were，非正式語境也可見 was)；主要子句用助動詞過去式 + 原形動詞。
g11-s1-u3.tip1.example: If I were a billionaire, I would fund marine plastic cleanup operations globally.

g11-s1-u3.x1.prompt: If I had more time now, I ___ another language.
g11-s1-u3.x1.hint: If + S + were / V-ed, S + would/could/should/might + V-原形
g11-s1-u3.x1.why: had 在此表現在假設，主句用 would + 原形 learn。

g11-s1-u3.tip2.title: 與過去相反之假設 (Subjunctive Unreal Past)
g11-s1-u3.tip2.formula: If + S + had + p.p., S + would/could/should/might + have + p.p.
g11-s1-u3.tip2.body: 與過去事實相反，子句動詞用過去完成式 had p.p.；主要子句用 would/could/should/might + have + p.p.。
g11-s1-u3.tip2.example: If we had left ten minutes earlier, we would not have missed the high-speed rail.

g11-s1-u3.x2.prompt: We left home late this morning. If we ___ ten minutes earlier, we ___ the high-speed train.
g11-s1-u3.x2.answer: had left; would not have missed
options: had left; would not have missed
g11-s1-u3.x2.hint: If + S + had + p.p., S + would/could/should/might + have + p.p.
g11-s1-u3.x2.why: 事實是出發太晚、錯過了車，屬於與過去事實相反的假設：if 子句用 had + p.p.，主要子句用 would have + p.p。

g11-s1-u3.tip3.title: 與未來相反之純假想 (Subjunctive Unreal Future)
g11-s1-u3.tip3.formula: If + S + were to / should + V-原形, S + would/could + V-原形
g11-s1-u3.tip3.body: were to 可提出較假設性的未來情境，不代表絕不可能；should 可表較正式、較不確定的條件，也不指定機率。
g11-s1-u3.tip3.example: If the sun were to rise in the west, I would still honor my promise.

g11-s1-u3.x3.prompt: If a typhoon ___ hit Taipei tomorrow, all flights would be cancelled.
g11-s1-u3.x3.hint: If + S + were to / should + V-原形, S + would/could + V-原形
g11-s1-u3.x3.why: 對未來提出假設性的情境，可用 If + S + were to + V，主要子句用 would + V。條件子句不用 will；has 與 is going 結構都不完整。

g11-s1-u3.q1.prompt: If the engineers ________ the thermal sensors beforehand, the catastrophic reactor meltdown could have been prevented.
g11-s1-u3.q1.hint: 先看主要子句 could have been prevented：這是對過去、現在還是未來的假設？

g11-s1-u3.trap1.answer: If I had known, I would have told you.

g11-s1-u4.tip1.title: 混合假設語氣 (Mixed Conditionals: Past Cause -> Present Effect)
g11-s1-u4.tip1.formula: If + S + had + p.p. (過去), S + would/could + V-原形 + now / today (現在)
g11-s1-u4.tip1.body: 條件子句是過去發生的事 (had p.p.)，但主要子句描述的是對「現在 (now)」造成的影響，主句使用 would + V-原形！
g11-s1-u4.tip1.example: If she had taken the vaccine last winter, she would not be sick in bed right now.

g11-s1-u4.x1.prompt: If Dr. Fleming ___ penicillin by accident in 1928, millions of lives would have been lost to bacterial infections.
g11-s1-u4.x1.hint: 主要子句是 would have been lost（與過去事實相反），條件子句要配合哪一種時態？
g11-s1-u4.x1.why: 【考點解構】此句針對 1928 年歷史事實進行「與過去事實相反的假設語氣」；條件句公式為 If + S + had (not) p.p.，主要子句配合 S + would have p.p.，故選 had not discovered。

g11-s1-u4.tip2.title: 省略 If 之倒裝三部曲 (Inversion by Omitting 'If')
g11-s1-u4.tip2.formula: Were + S... | Had + S + p.p... | Should + S + V-原形...
g11-s1-u4.tip2.body: 將 if 省略時，子句必須將助動詞或 be 動詞 (Were, Had, Should) 倒裝提至主詞之前！若有 not，not 留在主詞後方。
g11-s1-u4.tip2.example: If I had known => Had I known. / If you should see him => Should you see him. / If it were not for => Were it not for.

g11-s1-u4.x2.prompt: ___ you need any further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact our help desk.
g11-s1-u4.x2.hint: Were + S... | Had + S + p.p... | Should + S + V-原形...
g11-s1-u4.x2.why: Should + 主詞 + 原形動詞是省略 if 的倒裝（= If you should need...），表示「萬一」。Had 後須接過去分詞；Were 後不能直接接原形動詞 need；Did 不能引導條件句。

g11-s1-u4.q1.prompt: ________ the government implemented stringent quarantine protocols sooner, the outbreak would not have spread so rapidly across the province.
g11-s1-u4.q1.hint: 主要子句 would not have spread 表示與過去事實相反；想想條件子句可以用哪種句型開頭。
g11-s1-u4.q1.why: If the government had implemented... 省略 If 後倒裝為 Had the government implemented..。If had 不合文法；Should 與 Were 不能接過去分詞 implemented。

g11-s1-u4.trap1.answer: Had he not arrived in time, we would have failed.
options: Had he not arrived in time, we would have failed.
Had not he arrived in time, we would have failed.
g11-s1-u4.trap1.why: 省略 if 倒裝時，否定詞 not 不可與 Had 縮寫或一起提到句首，必須留在主詞之後。

g11-s1-u4.r1.passage: Had Captain Sullenberger hesitated for even a few seconds after both engines failed over New York City, the passenger aircraft might well have crashed into a densely populated neighborhood. Were modern flight simulators not equipped with realistic turbulence algorithms, pilots would be ill-prepared for catastrophic emergencies. Should any anomalies occur in flight telemetry today, onboard warning systems will immediately alert the crew.
g11-s1-u4.r1.passageTitle: Crisis Management in High-Stakes Aviation (高空飛行危機管理)
options: Travelers seldom witness a spectacle as transcendent...
g11-s1-u4.r1.hint: 倒裝結構還原：在閱讀中看到 Had / Were / Should 置於句首且句末是句號時，立即還原為 If 條件句。
g11-s1-u4.r1.why: 文章依據：Had Captain Sullenberger hesitated 為省略 if 的倒裝，還原即 If Captain Sullenberger had hesitated。

g11-s1-u5.tip1.title: 否定副詞置首不完全倒裝 (Negative Adverbial Inversion - Auxiliary First)
g11-s1-u5.tip1.formula: Negative Word (Never / Seldom / Rarely / Little / Not only / Hardly) + Auxiliary / Be + Subject + Main Verb...
g11-s1-u5.tip1.body: 否定副詞提至句首時，語序如同一般疑問句：助動詞 (do/does/did/have/can/will) 或 be 動詞必須倒裝提到主詞前方！
g11-s1-u5.tip1.example: Never in human history have so many individuals possessed instantaneous access to global knowledge.

g11-s1-u5.x1.prompt: ___ did the aerospace engineer realize that the sensor reading was corrupted by cosmic radiation.
g11-s1-u5.x1.hint: Negative Word (Never / Seldom / Rarely / Little / Not only / Hardly) + Auxiliary / Be + Subject + Main Verb...
g11-s1-u5.x1.why: 【考點解構】空格後方子句為助動詞倒裝結構 did the engineer realize（Aux + S + V）；依據文法規則，否定副詞或「Only + 時間副詞」置於句首時，主要子句必須倒裝，故選 Only then。

g11-s1-u5.tip2.title: 地方副詞置首完全倒裝 (Locative Inversion - Verb Before Subject)
g11-s1-u5.tip2.formula: Prep Phrase / Adverb of Place (On the hill / Under the tree / Here) + Verb + Noun Subject
g11-s1-u5.tip2.body: 地方副詞提至句首時，若主詞為普通名詞，整顆動詞直接搬到主詞前方 (完全倒裝)；但若主詞為代名詞 (he, they)，則不倒裝！
g11-s1-u5.tip2.example: At the foot of the mountain stood an ancient pagoda. vs. Here comes the bus! / Here it comes!

g11-s1-u5.x2.prompt: On the top of the hill ___ an ancient temple surrounded by pine trees.
g11-s1-u5.x2.hint: 地方介系詞片語放句首、主詞是名詞時，動詞與主詞的位置會怎麼變？
g11-s1-u5.x2.why: 地方副詞片語 On the top of the hill 置於句首、主詞為名詞 an ancient temple 時，採完全倒裝：地方片語 + 動詞 stands + 主詞。不需借助助動詞 does，也不可多加代名詞 it。

g11-s1-u5.q1.prompt: Little ________ that the anonymous donor who funded the research laboratory was actually their former mentor.
g11-s1-u5.q1.hint: 句首為否定副詞 Little（幾乎不／完全沒），想想後面的語序要怎麼改變。
g11-s1-u5.q1.why: Little 置於句首，語序需倒裝為助動詞 + 主詞 + 原形動詞 (did the scientists suspect)。

g11-s1-u5.r1.passage: Seldom do travelers witness a spectacle as transcendent as the aurora borealis dancing across the Arctic canopy. Across the frozen tundra swept biting polar winds, yet beneath the shimmering curtains of emerald light stood hundreds of spellbound spectators. Not only does this celestial phenomenon illuminate the polar night, but it also reveals the turbulent magnetic interactions shielding our planet from deadly solar radiation.
g11-s1-u5.r1.passageTitle: The Majesty of the Northern Lights (極光之美與地磁風暴)
g11-s1-u5.r1.prompt: Rewrite 'Seldom do travelers witness...' in standard non-inverted word order.
g11-s1-u5.r1.answer: Travelers seldom witness a spectacle as transcendent...
options: Travelers seldom witness a spectacle as transcendent...
After all safety checks had been completed.
g11-s1-u5.r1.hint: 倒裝句語氣體驗：圈出文中所有否定置首與方位置首的倒裝句，體會文學張力。
g11-s1-u5.r1.why: 文章依據：Travelers seldom witness a spectacle as transcendent...

gr.agreement.prompt: The list of materials ___ on the desk.
gr.agreement.why: 主詞核心 list 是單數，用 is。
gr.agreement.hint: 先找真正的主詞，別讓插入的介系詞片語干擾動詞單複數。倒裝與強調結構則改變排列，但仍需完整語法。

d.diag-0801.prompt: Seldom ___ such an inspiring oratorical performance on a public stage.

d.diag-0801.why: 否定副詞 Seldom 置於句首時，句子需採「主謂倒裝」：助動詞 (have) + 主詞 (I) + p.p. (witnessed)。 否定副詞句首倒裝選 have I witnessed。
d.diag-0801.topic: 否定副詞置於句首之主謂倒裝 (Never, Seldom, Hardly)

d.diag-0802.prompt: Never ___ that the modest student would invent a revolutionary green technology.
d.diag-0802.hint: 題意：我絕未料想到這位謙遜的學生竟會發明出革命性的綠色科技。
d.diag-0802.why: 否定副詞 Never 置於句首，過去式主謂倒裝：did + I + imagine。 Never 句首倒裝選 did I imagine。
d.diag-0802.topic: 否定副詞置於句首之主謂倒裝 (Never, Seldom, Hardly)

d.diag-0803.prompt: Hardly ___ asleep when an ear-splitting thunderclap shook the window panes.

d.diag-0803.why: Hardly... when... 固定句型，Hardly 句首使用過去完成式倒裝：had + he + fallen。 Hardly 句首倒裝選 had he fallen。
d.diag-0803.topic: 否定副詞置於句首之主謂倒裝 (Never, Seldom, Hardly)

d.diag-0804.prompt: Rarely ___ so deeply engrossed in a classic novel.

d.diag-0804.why: Rarely 置於句首倒裝：have I been。 Rarely 句首倒裝選 have I been。
d.diag-0804.topic: 否定副詞置於句首之主謂倒裝 (Never, Seldom, Hardly)

d.diag-0805.prompt: Scarcely ___ the terminal building when the torrential downpour erupted.

d.diag-0805.topic: 否定副詞置於句首之主謂倒裝 (Never, Seldom, Hardly)

d.diag-0806.prompt: Not until the morning light penetrated the dense canopy ___ the lost hikers.
d.diag-0806.hint: 題意：直到晨光穿透濃密的樹冠，搜救隊才終於找到了走失的登山客。
d.diag-0806.why: Not until + 時間狀語置於句首，主要子句採倒裝：did rescuers locate。 Not until 句首主句倒裝選 did rescuers locate。

g11-s1-u6.tip1.title: So... that... 與 Such... that... 倒裝 (Inversion of So/Such Result Clauses)
g11-s1-u6.tip1.formula: So + Adj/Adv + Be/Auxiliary + Subject + that... | Such + Be + Subject + that...
g11-s1-u6.tip1.body: 將「如此...以致於...」的 So + 形容詞提至句首加強語氣時，前半句倒裝，that 後面子句維持正常語序。
g11-s1-u6.tip1.example: So intense was the summer heatwave that asphalt roads began to soften.

g11-s1-u6.x1.prompt: So exhausted ___ after the marathon that she fell asleep on the bus home.
g11-s1-u6.x1.hint: So + 形容詞放在句首時，後面的語序會怎麼改變？
g11-s1-u6.x1.why: So + 形容詞 exhausted 置於句首時，主要子句須倒裝；本句動詞為 be 動詞 was，故倒裝為 was she。exhausted 是形容詞，不能用 did 倒裝。

g11-s1-u6.tip2.title: Neither / Nor 的附和倒裝 (Negative Agreement Inversion)
g11-s1-u6.tip2.formula: S + negative verb...; neither / nor + Be/Auxiliary + Subject
g11-s1-u6.tip2.body: 表達「某人/某物也不...」時，neither / nor 後面必須將 be 動詞或助動詞提至主詞之前。
g11-s1-u6.tip2.example: The pilot could not see through the dense fog, nor could the radar detect the mountain ridge.

g11-s1-u6.x2.prompt: The manager didn't approve the budget, and ___ the board members.
g11-s1-u6.x2.hint: S + negative verb...; neither / nor + Be/Auxiliary + Subject
g11-s1-u6.x2.why: 前句為否定（didn't approve），附和否定要用 neither + 助動詞 + 主詞；前句助動詞是 did，故用 neither did。so did 用於肯定附和；either 不能放句首倒裝；were 與 approve 不呼應。

g11-s1-u6.q1.prompt: So captivating ________ that the entire auditorium remained spellbound for over two hours.
g11-s1-u6.q1.hint: 句首為 So + 形容詞 captivating（如此引人入勝），想想後面的主詞與動詞語序要怎麼改變。
g11-s1-u6.q1.why: So + Adj. 置首倒裝，be 動詞 was 倒裝至主詞 the performance 前。

g11-s1-u6.trap1.answer: He doesn't like spicy food, and neither do I.
options: He doesn't like spicy food, and neither do I.
He doesn't like spicy food, and I don't too.
g11-s1-u6.trap1.why: 否定附和句不能用 too，只能用 either（放句尾，如 and I don't either）或 neither + 助動詞 + 主詞（倒裝）。

g11-s1-u6.r1.passage: During the darkest hours of the Blitz in 1940, Winston Churchill galvanized a beleaguered nation. So profound was his mastery of language that his speeches mobilized the English language and sent it into battle. Not only did his steadfast resolve inspire Londoners enduring nightly bombardments, but it also forged an indomitable transatlantic alliance that ultimately vanquished fascism.
g11-s1-u6.r1.passageTitle: Winston Churchill's Wartime Rhetoric: Defiance Against Tyranny (邱吉爾戰時演說修辭剖析)
g11-s1-u6.r1.prompt: What happened to the word order after 'So profound'?
g11-s1-u6.r1.answer: The auxiliary/be verb was placed before the subject (was his mastery).
options: The auxiliary/be verb was placed before the subject (was his mastery).
Travelers seldom witness a spectacle as transcendent...
g11-s1-u6.r1.hint: 修辭對稱性標記：找出演說文獻中 So... that 與 Not only 的對稱倒裝句型。
g11-s1-u6.r1.why: 文章依據：The auxiliary/be verb was placed before the subject (was his mastery).

d.diag-0891.prompt: Successful leaders must be capable of listening attentively, communicating clearly, and ___ effectively.
d.diag-0891.hint: 題意：成功的領導者必須具備專注傾聽、清晰溝通以及有效協作的能力。
d.diag-0891.why: 平行結構：of listening..., communicating..., and collaborating... 三者皆需為動名詞 (V-ing)！ 平行對等動名詞選 collaborating。

d.diag-0892.prompt: The internship program offers students opportunities to gain experience, expand networks, and ___ professional skills.
d.diag-0892.hint: 題意：該實習計畫為學生提供累積經驗、拓展人脈以及培養專業技能的機會。
d.diag-0892.why: 不定詞後平行原形動詞：to gain..., expand..., and develop... 三者皆為原形動詞！ 平行原形動詞選 develop。

d.diag-0893.prompt: Tony enjoys hiking in the high mountains, camping near the pristine lakes, and ___ scenic landscape photos.
d.diag-0893.hint: 題意：Tony 熱愛在高山健行、在清澈湖畔露營以及拍攝壯麗的風景照片。
d.diag-0893.why: enjoy 後平行動名詞：hiking..., camping..., and taking... 一致採用 V-ing！ 平行動名詞選 taking。

d.diag-0894.prompt: The newly opened library is spacious, well-illuminated, and ___ organized.
d.diag-0894.hint: 題意：這座新開放的圖書館空間寬敞、採光明亮且整理得井井有條細緻入微。
d.diag-0894.why: 平行副詞修飾過去分詞 organized：spacious, well-illuminated, and meticulously organized。 修飾分詞平行選副詞 meticulously。

d.diag-0895.prompt: Emily is admired for her intellectual brilliance, artistic creativity, and ___ commitment.
d.diag-0895.hint: 題意：Emily 因其才智過人、藝術創造力以及堅定不移的奉獻精神而受到欽佩。
d.diag-0895.why: 平行形容詞修飾名詞：brilliance, creativity, and unwavering commitment。 平行形容詞選 unwavering。

d.diag-0896.prompt: The doctor advised the patient not only to modify his diet but also ___ regularly.
d.diag-0896.hint: 題意：醫生建議病患不僅要調整飲食結構，而且還要定期運動。
d.diag-0896.why: not only to modify... but also to exercise... 不定詞對等平行！ 不定詞平行選 to exercise。

d.diag-0897.prompt: The novel is notable for its captivating plot, authentic dialogue, and ___ character development.
d.diag-0897.hint: 題意：這部小說以其引人入勝的情節、真實自然的對白以及深刻的人物刻畫而著稱。
d.diag-0897.why: 平行名詞片語結構：captivating plot, authentic dialogue, and profound development。 平行形容詞選 profound。

d.diag-0898.prompt: He is respected whether he is speaking to corporate executives, guiding young students, or ___ with everyday citizens.
d.diag-0898.hint: 題意：無論他是與企業高層對話、指導年輕學子，還是與尋常百姓互動，他都深受尊敬。
d.diag-0898.why: speaking..., guiding..., or interacting... 平行現在分詞！ 平行現在分詞選 interacting。

d.diag-0899.prompt: The school policy aims to reduce student stress, promote physical health, and ___ academic creativity.
d.diag-0899.hint: 題意：學校政策旨在減輕學生壓力、促進身體健康並培養學術創造力。
d.diag-0899.why: aims to reduce..., promote..., and foster... 原形動詞平行！ 平行原形動詞選 foster。

d.diag-0900.prompt: The athletic trainer instructed players to warm up thoroughly, hydrate frequently, and ___ properly.
d.diag-0900.hint: 題意：體能訓練師指導球員們要徹底熱身、頻繁補水並適當進行拉伸。
d.diag-0900.why: instructed to warm up..., hydrate..., and stretch... 原形動詞對等！ 平行原形動詞選 stretch。

d.diag-0901.prompt: The more diligently you practice, the ___ proficient you will become in English.
d.diag-0901.why: 雙重比較級句型：The + 比較級... , the + 比較級... 表示「越…就越…」。 雙重比較級選 the more proficient。
d.diag-0901.topic: 雙重比較級 (The more..., the more...)

d.diag-0902.prompt: The higher we ascended the mountain trail, the ___ the air became.
d.diag-0902.hint: 題意：我們沿著山徑登得越高，空氣就變得越發寒冷。
d.diag-0902.why: The higher..., the colder... 雙重比較級搭配 colder。 雙重比較級選 colder。
d.diag-0902.topic: 雙重比較級 (The more..., the more...)

d.diag-0903.prompt: The more complex the technological dilemma, the ___ ingenuity is required to solve it.
d.diag-0903.why: The more complex..., the more ingenuity... 雙重比較級。 雙重比較級選 more。
d.diag-0903.topic: 雙重比較級 (The more..., the more...)

d.diag-0904.prompt: The sooner you begin your research project, the ___ your final grade will be.

g11-s2-u7.tip1.title: 分裂句標準公式與還原檢驗法 (Cleft Sentence Formula & Test)
g11-s2-u7.tip1.formula: It is / was + [強調焦點 (S / O / Adv Phrase)] + that / who + [剩餘句子成分]
g11-s2-u7.tip1.body: 檢驗方法：若把 'It is/was' 和 'that' 同時拿掉，剩下的單字能重新還原拼成一句完整的正常句子，就是分裂強調句！
g11-s2-u7.tip1.example: Columbus reached the Americas in 1492. => It was in 1492 that Columbus reached the Americas.

g11-s2-u7.x1.prompt: Original: Columbus reached the Americas in 1492. Which sentence emphasizes the YEAR?
g11-s2-u7.x1.answer: It was in 1492 that Columbus reached the Americas.
options: It was Columbus that reached the Americas in 1492.
It was in 1492 that Columbus reached the Americas.
It was the Americas that Columbus reached in 1492.
It is 1492 when Columbus reached the Americas.
g11-s2-u7.x1.hint: It is / was + [強調焦點 (S / O / Adv Phrase)] + that / who + [剩餘句子成分]
g11-s2-u7.x1.why: 分裂句：It was + 焦點 + that + 其餘部分。強調年份就把 in 1492 放進焦點；拿掉 It was…that 後可還原原句。最後一句時態與結構都不正確。

g11-s2-u7.tip2.title: Wh- 分裂句 (Pseudo-cleft Sentences)
g11-s2-u7.tip2.formula: What + S + V + is / was + [強調焦點]
g11-s2-u7.tip2.body: 以 what 子句作為主詞，將整個句子的核心焦點推移至 be 動詞之後。
g11-s2-u7.tip2.example: What the biosphere urgently requires is substantive decarbonization, not hollow pledges.

g11-s2-u7.x2.prompt: Which pseudo-cleft sentence correctly puts the focus on "a quiet place to study"?
g11-s2-u7.x2.answer: What I need is a quiet place to study.
options: What I need is a quiet place to study.
What I need are a quiet place to study.
That I need is a quiet place to study.
What do I need is a quiet place to study.
g11-s2-u7.x2.hint: What + S + V + is / was + [強調焦點]
g11-s2-u7.x2.why: What 子句當主詞時視為單數，後接 is；焦點放在 be 動詞之後。What 子句內用直述語序 I need，不能寫成 do I need。

g11-s2-u8.tip1.body: 意為「雖然...、儘管...」。將形容詞、副詞、原形動詞或名詞 (不可加冠詞 a/an) 提至 as/though 前方！注意：although 絕不可用於此倒裝結構！
g11-s2-u8.tip1.example: Rich as he is, he remains humble. / Child as she was, she displayed astonishing courage. / Hard as they tried, they failed.

g11-s2-u8.x1.prompt: ___ as the task seemed, the team finished it ahead of schedule.
g11-s2-u8.x1.hint: 讓步倒裝：把要強調的字放在 as 前面，後面接主詞＋動詞。想想 seemed 後面原本接什麼詞性？
g11-s2-u8.x1.why: 原句 Although the task seemed difficult → 讓步倒裝 Difficult as the task seemed。seemed 後接形容詞，故把形容詞 Difficult 提到 as 前；Although 不能與 as 並用，名詞 Difficulty 不能當 seem 的補語，How difficult 是感嘆／疑問用法。

g11-s2-u8.tip2.title: 高級讓步與假設片語 (Advanced Idiomatic Concessions)
g11-s2-u8.tip2.formula: Be it A or B (無論是A還是B) | Come what may (無論發生什麼) | Be that as it may (儘管如此)
g11-s2-u8.tip2.body: 源自古英語虛擬式原形倒裝，廣泛保留於現代新聞評論、法學與大考長文中。
g11-s2-u8.tip2.example: Every participant must register, be they students or renowned scholars.

g11-s2-u8.x2.prompt: Every visitor must sign in at the front desk, ___ a student or a professor.
g11-s2-u8.x2.hint: 這裡要表達「無論是學生還是教授」；想想表讓步時，be 動詞要用什麼形式、放在哪裡。
g11-s2-u8.x2.why: be it A or B（無論是 A 還是 B）是保留虛擬原形的倒裝讓步句型；is it 是疑問語序，不能表示讓步。

g11-s2-u8.q1.prompt: ________ as he was, the apprentice managed to repair the intricate clockwork mechanism.
g11-s2-u8.q1.hint: 本句是把名詞提到 as 前面的讓步倒裝（as he was）；想想名詞提前時，冠詞與單複數要怎麼處理。
g11-s2-u8.q1.why: 名詞提至 as/though 前倒裝表讓步時，名詞前不加冠詞。故選 Novice。

g11-s2-u8.trap1.answer: Brave though he was, he could not defeat the beast.

g11-s2-u9.tip1.title: 學術科技英文摘要四大結構 (Four Pillars of Academic Abstracts)
g11-s2-u9.tip1.formula: Objective (研究目的) -> Methodology (研究方法) -> Findings (實驗結果) -> Implications (實務意涵)
g11-s2-u9.tip1.body: 科技論文摘要依循嚴密脈絡。善用定位詞快速抓取核心貢獻。
g11-s2-u9.tip1.example: This paper proposes a novel Transformer architecture capable of mitigating hallucinations in LLMs.

g11-s2-u9.x1.prompt: In a research abstract, which sentence most likely reports the FINDINGS?
g11-s2-u9.x1.answer: Results show that weekly AI feedback reduced grammar errors by 18%.
options: This study aims to examine how AI tutors affect writing accuracy.
We surveyed 300 students across five high schools.
Results show that weekly AI feedback reduced grammar errors by 18%.
These results suggest that schools should combine AI and teacher feedback.
g11-s2-u9.x1.hint: Objective (研究目的) -> Methodology (研究方法) -> Findings (實驗結果) -> Implications (實務意涵)
g11-s2-u9.x1.why: 摘要常依序寫：目的（aims to）→ 方法（surveyed…）→ 結果（Results show…，常帶數據）→ 意涵（suggest that…should）。

g11-s2-u9.tip2.title: 科技詞彙構詞法：字根與字首拆解 (Affixation in Technical ESP)
g11-s2-u9.tip2.formula: neuro- (神經) | bio- (生物) | auto- (自動) | trans- (轉變/跨越) | -ification (名詞化)
g11-s2-u9.tip2.body: 字根字首可提供推測線索，但不能保證推得詞義；仍需用上下文與字典核對。
g11-s2-u9.tip2.example: Autonomous neuromuscular synchronization allows bionic prosthetics to emulate natural limb movements.

g11-s2-u9.x2.hint: 把字拆成字首 re-、字根 use、字尾 -able，分別想想它們的意思。
g11-s2-u9.x2.why: re- 表再一次，use + -able 表能被使用；仍須以實際詞義核對拆字推論。

g11-s2-u11.tip1.title: 篇章連貫四大定錨法則 (Four Anchoring Principles of Discourse Cohesion)
g11-s2-u11.tip1.formula: 1. 代名詞定錨 (they, this, such) -> 2. 定冠詞特定指稱 (the + N) -> 3. 轉折語流 (However, Thus) -> 4. 語意回響 (Lexical Reiteration)
g11-s2-u11.tip1.body: 檢查空格前後的指涉與邏輯，必要時回看整段；線索數量不固定，也不一定出現代名詞。

g11-s2-u11.x1.prompt: Dr. Evans launched a project to clean up the river. Which sentence best follows?
g11-s2-u11.x1.answer: This ambitious effort attracted over 200 volunteers.
options: This ambitious effort attracted over 200 volunteers.

They are also popular among tourists.
For example, the weather was sunny.
g11-s2-u11.x1.hint: 1. 代名詞定錨 (they, this, such) -> 2. 定冠詞特定指稱 (the + N) -> 3. 轉折語流 (However, Thus) -> 4. 語意回響 (Lexical Reiteration)
g11-s2-u11.x1.why: This ambitious effort 用「this + 概括名詞」回指前句的 project，指涉鏈完整。However 沒有可對比的內容；They 找不到複數先行詞；天氣的例子和前句無關。

g11-s2-u11.r1.passage: In 1799, French soldiers in Egypt unearthed a slab of granodiorite inscribed with three distinct scripts: Ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs, Demotic script, and Ancient Greek. Because scholars could readily read the Greek inscriptions, they possessed a linguistic key. Jean-François Champollion hypothesized that the hieroglyphic characters represented phonetic sounds rather than merely symbolic pictograms. By meticulously cross-referencing royal cartouches such as 'Ptolemy' and 'Cleopatra', he unlocked the forgotten language of the Pharaohs.
g11-s2-u11.r1.passageTitle: The Decipherment of the Rosetta Stone (羅塞塔石碑破譯全紀錄)
g11-s2-u11.r1.prompt: What did the Ancient Greek script provide for the researchers?
g11-s2-u11.r1.answer: A linguistic key to compare and decipher the hieroglyphs.
options: A linguistic key to compare and decipher the hieroglyphs.

k.stories-poems-drama.tip.title: 閱讀故事、詩歌與短劇：情節、韻律與感想
k.stories-poems-drama.tip.formula: 讀懂故事與短劇的背景、人物、衝突與結局，欣賞詩歌韻律與字詞之美，並以英語發表賞析心得。
k.stories-poems-drama.tip.body: 故事要素：setting（背景）、characters（人物）、conflict（衝突）、climax（高潮）、resolution（結局）。短劇另有舞台指示（stage directions，常以斜體或括號表示）與對白，朗讀時要用語氣呈現人物情緒。詩歌欣賞看三點：押韻與節奏（rhyme、meter）、意象（imagery，用感官描寫）、修辭（simile 明喻 like/as、metaphor 暗喻、personification 擬人）。寫心得用「摘要一句 → 引用一句 → 分析效果 → 個人連結」。
k.stories-poems-drama.tip.example: The wind whispered through the trees. / Her smile was as bright as the morning sun.

d.diag-0991.hint: 題意：篇章結構分析：哪一句最適合作為探討再生能源段落的主題句（Topic Sentence）？
d.diag-0991.why: 主題句需具備概括性、前瞻性與核心論點：轉向再生能源對防止氣候變遷至關重要。 段落主題句選具概括性論點之句子。
d.diag-0991.topic: 篇章結構閱讀：主題句、支持句與結論句呼應

d.diag-0992.prompt: READING STRUCTURE: Which sentence provides the strongest Supporting Evidence for the claim that exercise boosts academic achievement?
options: Many students enjoy wearing running shoes.
The gym was repainted during summer vacation.
Exercise equipment can be quite costly.
Neuroscientific studies show that aerobic exercise enhances hippocampal memory retention by 15%.
d.diag-0992.answer: Neuroscientific studies show that aerobic exercise enhances hippocampal memory retention by 15%.
d.diag-0992.hint: 題意：支持句分析：哪一句為「運動能提升學業成績」的主張提供了最強力的支持性證據（Supporting Evidence）？
d.diag-0992.why: 神經科學實證數據直接連結有氧運動與記憶保留率提升15%，為最強力支持證據。 實證數據支持句最有力。
d.diag-0992.topic: 篇章結構閱讀：主題句、支持句與結論句呼應

d.diag-0993.prompt: READING STRUCTURE: Identify the sentence that best functions as a Concluding Sentence summarizing a passage on digital literacy.
options: Ultimately, equipping students with critical digital literacy is fundamental to nurturing informed democratic citizens.
Some students prefer tablets over desktop computers.
d.diag-0993.answer: Ultimately, equipping students with critical digital literacy is fundamental to nurturing informed democratic citizens.
d.diag-0993.hint: 題意：結論句分析：哪一句最能作為總結數位素養文章的結論句（Concluding Sentence）？
d.diag-0993.why: 以 Ultimately（終極而言）總結培養具備批判性數位素養是培育明智公民之基石。 總結性結論句以 Ultimately 總攬核心價值。
d.diag-0993.topic: 篇章結構閱讀：主題句、支持句與結論句呼應

d.diag-0994.prompt: READING STRUCTURE: What is the primary rhetorical function of a Transition Sentence between paragraph two and three?
options: To repeat word-for-word the introductory hook.
To bridge the previous paragraph's discussion of environmental hazards with the next paragraph's proposed solutions.
To list technical glossary definitions in alphabetical order.
d.diag-0994.answer: To bridge the previous paragraph's discussion of environmental hazards with the next paragraph's proposed solutions.
d.diag-0994.hint: 題意：第二段與第三段之間的轉折句（Transition Sentence）主要的修辭功能是什麼？
d.diag-0994.why: 銜接句功能為承上啟下。 正確選項為「To bridge the previous paragraph's discussion of environmental hazards with the next paragraph's proposed solutions.」。其他選項在詞性、語境搭配或邏輯推論上存在明顯漏洞。
d.diag-0994.topic: 篇章結構閱讀：主題句、支持句與結論句呼應

d.diag-0995.prompt: READING STRUCTURE: If a paragraph discusses the drawbacks of urban sprawl, which sentence should be excluded as Irrelevant Information?
options: Urban sprawl leads to habitat fragmentation and biodiversity loss.
The city's founding mayor was born on a Tuesday in April.
Suburban commuters often spend ninety minutes daily navigating highway congestion.
Sprawling infrastructure increases municipal maintenance expenditures.
d.diag-0995.answer: The city's founding mayor was born on a Tuesday in April.
d.diag-0995.hint: 題意：在探討都市蔓延弊端的段落中，哪一句與主旨無關、應該刪除？
d.diag-0995.why: 段落主旨是都市蔓延的弊端；棲地破碎化、通勤塞車、維護成本增加都是弊端的例證，只有市長出生日期與主旨無關，應刪除。
d.diag-0995.topic: 篇章結構閱讀：主題句、支持句與結論句呼應

d.diag-0996.prompt: READING STRUCTURE: In an argumentative essay advocating for art education, where should the Counter-Argument be placed?
options: At the very end of the bibliography citation list.
In the footnote of page one.
Hidden inside parentheses within the title.
In a dedicated body paragraph followed immediately by a robust refutation.
d.diag-0996.answer: In a dedicated body paragraph followed immediately by a robust refutation.
d.diag-0996.hint: 題意：在提倡藝術教育的議論文中，反方論點（Counter-Argument）應該放在哪裡？
d.diag-0996.why: 駁論段結構：提出反方論點並緊隨反駁駁斥。 正確選項為「In a dedicated body paragraph followed immediately by a robust refutation.」。其他選項在詞性、語境搭配或邏輯推論上存在明顯漏洞。
d.diag-0996.topic: 篇章結構閱讀：主題句、支持句與結論句呼應

d.diag-0997.prompt: READING STRUCTURE: Which concluding transition signals a final synthesized takeaway in academic discourse?
options: Taken together, these empirical findings underscore the necessity of comprehensive reform.
By the way, did you know that paper is made from trees?
Anyway, I have to go now.
As I was saying earlier, cats are cute.
d.diag-0997.answer: Taken together, these empirical findings underscore the necessity of comprehensive reform.
d.diag-0997.hint: 題意：哪一個結論轉折語能在學術文章中引出最後的綜合結論？
d.diag-0997.why: 學術總結標記選 Taken together。 正確選項為「Taken together, these empirical findings underscore the necessity of comprehensive reform.」。其他選項在詞性、語境搭配或邏輯推論上存在明顯漏洞。
d.diag-0997.topic: 篇章結構閱讀：主題句、支持句與結論句呼應

d.diag-0998.prompt: READING STRUCTURE: What structural role does an Anecdotal Hook serve in the introductory paragraph?
options: To prove statistical validity beyond any doubt.
To engage the reader's emotional interest before introducing the central thesis statement.
To fulfill minimum word count requirements.
To summarize the entire conclusion prematurely.
d.diag-0998.answer: To engage the reader's emotional interest before introducing the central thesis statement.
d.diag-0998.hint: 題意：開頭段落中的軼事引子（Anecdotal Hook）扮演什麼結構角色？
d.diag-0998.why: 引子功能為吸引讀者興趣。 正確選項為「To engage the reader's emotional interest before introducing the central thesis statement.」。其他選項在詞性、語境搭配或邏輯推論上存在明顯漏洞。
d.diag-0998.topic: 篇章結構閱讀：主題句、支持句與結論句呼應

d.diag-0999.prompt: READING STRUCTURE: In a cause-and-effect essay on ocean acidification, the thesis statement should clearly identify:
options: Only the price of seafood in local markets.
The life story of a fictional fisherman.
Both the underlying chemical causes and the ecological ramifications.
A list of famous beach resort hotels.
d.diag-0999.answer: Both the underlying chemical causes and the ecological ramifications.
d.diag-0999.hint: 題意：在探討海洋酸化的因果文中，主旨句應清楚指出什麼？
d.diag-0999.why: 因果文中心句需涵蓋原因與後果。 正確選項為「Both the underlying chemical causes and the ecological ramifications.」。其他選項在詞性、語境搭配或邏輯推論上存在明顯漏洞。
d.diag-0999.topic: 篇章結構閱讀：主題句、支持句與結論句呼應

d.diag-1000.prompt: READING STRUCTURE: How do cohesive devices such as 'Furthermore' and 'In contrast' enhance text coherence?

By hiding grammatical mistakes within the paragraph.
By replacing all verbs with nouns.
By establishing explicit logical relationships between consecutive arguments.
d.diag-1000.answer: By establishing explicit logical relationships between consecutive arguments.
d.diag-1000.hint: 題意：Furthermore、In contrast 等銜接詞如何增進文章的連貫性？
d.diag-1000.why: 篇章銜接詞建立明確邏輯關聯。 正確選項為「By establishing explicit logical relationships between consecutive arguments.」。其他選項在詞性、語境搭配或邏輯推論上存在明顯漏洞。
d.diag-1000.topic: 篇章結構閱讀：主題句、支持句與結論句呼應

d.diag-0911.prompt: Traditional fossil fuels emit vast amounts of greenhouse gases. ___, renewable solar energy is clean and virtually limitless.
d.diag-0911.hint: 題意：傳統化石燃料排放大量溫室氣體。相反地，再生太陽能乾淨且幾乎無窮無盡。
d.diag-0911.why: 前後句對立對比，使用 Conversely（相反地、反之）。 相反對比選 Conversely。

d.diag-0912.prompt: The medical procedure carried severe potential risks; ___, the patient chose to undergo it.
d.diag-0912.hint: 題意：這項醫療手術伴隨著嚴重的潛在風險；儘管如此，病患依然選擇接受該手術。
d.diag-0912.why: 風險極高與依然選擇接受形成讓步轉折，使用 nevertheless（儘管如此）。 讓步轉折選 nevertheless。

d.diag-0913.prompt: The factory violated environmental regulations repeatedly. ___, it was slapped with hefty government fines.
d.diag-0913.hint: 題意：該工廠屢次違反環保法規。因此，它遭到了政府巨額罰款的重罰處分。
d.diag-0913.why: 違規（因）導致罰款（果），副詞使用 Consequently（因此、結果）。 因果後果選 Consequently。

d.diag-0914.prompt: Regular cardiovascular exercise enhances physical stamina. ___, it reduces risks of chronic ailments.
d.diag-0914.hint: 題意：規律心血管運動增強身體耐力。此外，它還能降低罹患慢性病痛的風險。
d.diag-0914.why: 進一步正面補充益處，使用 Furthermore（此外）。 正面遞進選 Furthermore。

d.diag-0915.prompt: Critics claimed the new smartphone model would flop. ___, it became the bestselling device of the year.
d.diag-0915.hint: 題意：評論家曾宣稱這款新手機型號將會慘遭滑鐵盧。正相反，它成了年度最暢銷的智慧設備。
d.diag-0915.why: 否定前面的負面預測並引出完全相反的正面事實，使用 On the contrary（恰恰相反）。 完全相反的事實選 On the contrary。

d.diag-0916.prompt: Urban rents have escalated beyond affordability. ___, many young professionals are relocating to suburban districts.
d.diag-0916.hint: 題意：城市房租已飛漲到難以負擔的地步。結果，許多年輕職場專業人士正遷往郊區城鎮。
d.diag-0916.why: 房租高（因）引發遷徙（果），選 As a result（結果）。 因果結果選 As a result。

g10-s2-u10.q1.prompt: Which verb best completes the sentence?
g10-s2-u10.q1.hint: 注意空格後的 at only 28% 與 barely changing over the past three years 描述的是什麼趨勢。
g10-s2-u10.q1.why: plateau at + 數值 表示停在某一水準、不再上升；barely changing（幾乎沒變）排除了 surged（暴增）、plummeted（暴跌）與 fluctuated wildly（劇烈波動），故選 plateaued。
g10-s2-u10.q1.passage: A municipal report shows a gap between attitudes and actions. While 84% of surveyed households expressed intense concern over microplastic contamination, actual sorted recycling participation ________ at only 28%, barely changing over the past three years.

g10-s2-u10.r1.passage: A municipal report published yesterday presents paradoxical findings regarding consumer behavior. While 84% of surveyed households expressed intense concern over microplastic contamination, actual sorted recycling participation plateaued at only 28%. The accompanying bar chart reveals that single-use plastic consumption among young adults rose by 14% this year, largely driven by online delivery services. Environmental advocates argue that consumer awareness campaigns are insufficient without legislative bans.
g10-s2-u10.r1.passageTitle: Global Plastic Waste Management and Recycling Realities (全球塑膠廢棄物現況分析)
g10-s2-u10.r1.prompt: According to the passage, what specific service caused the 14% increase in single-use plastics?
options: Because 'to' in 'be accustomed to' is a preposition requiring a gerund.
Because it manipulates qubits simultaneously using superposition and entanglement.
g10-s2-u10.r1.hint: 圖表與文本綜合對照：比對內文敘述百分比與統計圖數據是否一致。

g10-s2-u10.x1.prompt: Sales rose from 100 to 120 units. Which description is accurate?

g10-s2-u10.x1.why: 增加 20，除以原值 100 得 20%；doubled 代表變成 200。

g10-s2-u10.x2.prompt: Text A supports remote work for flexibility. Text B supports it but asks for better training. What do both support?
